rows.grounds: neuter accusative singular of prakāśamātra; compound of prakāśa and mātra
adjective accusative singular neuter agreeing with bhāvācāraṃ
neuter accusative singular compound of bhāva and ācāra
vocative singular feminine address to Maheśvarī

items.question: What is the threefold state-conduct that is manifestation-only, addressed to the supreme goddess?
items.inference: The verse presents a threefold conduct of states as mere manifestation addressed to Maheśvarī.
uncertainties: prakāśamātraṃ may modify bhāvācāraṃ or stand as a separate qualifier.
The exact three divisions are not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: O supreme goddess, the threefold conduct of states is manifestation only.
